module.purpose: Handles seat-specific booking operations by locating an accepted booking, creating or rescheduling a seated attendee, and triggering workflow reminders and webhooks.
module.summary: This module coordinates the booking-seat flow. It queries Prisma for the relevant accepted booking, prevents duplicate attendee enrollment, dispatches either seat creation or seated-booking rescheduling, then schedules reminders and emits webhook payloads when a booking result exists. Dry runs exit before database access, while reminder failures are logged without preventing webhook delivery.
module.businessContext: Supports multi-attendee event bookings where invitees occupy individual seats. Failures can prevent seat assignment, reminders, or downstream booking integrations from being updated.
functions: handleSeats (~L16-161): Locates seated bookings, mutates seat assignments, and triggers downstream notifications

io: Queries Prisma for the accepted booking matching a reschedule or event-time criterion.
Logs reminder scheduling errors through the booking event logger.
network: Schedules workflow reminders for the resulting seated booking.
Triggers downstream booking webhooks for the resulting seated booking.

sectionMap.name: dry-run guard
sectionMap.intent: Stops processing before logger creation or database access during dry runs.

sectionMap.name: accepted booking lookup
sectionMap.intent: Loads the accepted booking and related attendee, user, and seat data.

sectionMap.name: missing rescheduled booking
sectionMap.intent: Rejects rescheduling when no matching accepted booking exists.

sectionMap.name: missing booking exit
sectionMap.intent: Treats an absent booking without reschedule context as a no-op.

sectionMap.name: duplicate attendee guard
sectionMap.intent: Rejects an attendee already assigned to the same booking timeslot.

sectionMap.name: seat mutation dispatch
sectionMap.intent: Selects rescheduling or new-seat creation based on reschedule context.

sectionMap.name: reminder orchestration
sectionMap.intent: Schedules reminders and logs scheduling failures without aborting webhook processing.

sectionMap.name: webhook emission
sectionMap.intent: Builds an accepted-booking payload and sends it to webhook subscribers.

edgeCases.behavior: Returns immediately without querying or mutating bookings.

edgeCases.inputShape: No accepted booking and rescheduleUid is provided
edgeCases.behavior: Throws HttpError with status 404 and BookingNotFound.

edgeCases.inputShape: Invitee email already exists and formatted start time matches
edgeCases.behavior: Throws HttpError with status 409 and AlreadySignedUpForBooking.
Logs the error and continues to construct and emit the webhook.

edgeCases.inputShape: Seat operation returns null or undefined
edgeCases.behavior: Skips reminder and webhook orchestration, then returns the empty result.

boundaryConditions.intent: Detects whether the invitee email is already assigned to an attendee.
Requires the duplicate attendee check to target the same formatted timeslot.
Includes existing metadata only when the result metadata is object-shaped.

errorHandling.action: Aborts processing when a requested rescheduled booking cannot be found.
Aborts processing when the invitee is already signed up for the same timeslot.
Logs the reminder scheduling error and continues with webhook construction.

invariants.description: The input object supplies event, invitee, event, and booking context required by downstream seat handlers.
Only bookings with ACCEPTED status are eligible for seat operations.
Reminder scheduling and webhook emission occur only when a seat operation returns a result booking.
Seat mutation completes before workflow reminders and webhook notification are attempted.
The function returns the resulting booking when downstream seat processing produces one.

assumptions.description: The caller supplies invitee[0] and valid event and booking context expected by the seat handlers.
Prisma returns attendee, booking, user, reference, and seat relations matching the selected shape.
Downstream seat handlers return a result booking when reminder and webhook orchestration should occur.

ambiguities.question: Does the database OR query intentionally allow a booking found by event time to substitute for a missing requested booking UID?
ambiguities.affects: accepted booking lookup and missing-booking behavior

ambiguities.question: Can scheduleWorkflowReminders perform externally visible work that requires stronger failure handling than logging?

concurrencyModel.notes: Each invocation awaits database lookup, seat mutation, reminder scheduling, and webhook triggering in sequence; no shared mutable state is declared.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A dry-run seat operation is requested.
moduleContractTests.then: resolves with undefined without querying or mutating bookings
moduleContractTests.rationale: Dry runs must exit before database access and side effects.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A reschedule UID does not identify an accepted booking.
moduleContractTests.then: throws HttpError with statusCode 404 and message ErrorCode.BookingNotFound
moduleContractTests.rationale: Rescheduling requires an existing accepted booking.

moduleContractTests.scenario: No accepted booking matches the requested seat operation and no reschedule UID is supplied.
moduleContractTests.rationale: New seat creation is skipped when there is no seated booking.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The invitee is already an attendee for the same booking start time.
given: seatedBooking.attendees contains an attendee whose email equals invitee[0].email
moduleContractTests.then: throws HttpError with statusCode 409 and message ErrorCode.AlreadySignedUpForBooking
moduleContractTests.rationale: An attendee cannot be seated twice in the same timeslot.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An accepted seated booking exists and the request is not a reschedule.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Non-reschedule requests must use the seat creation path.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An accepted seated booking exists and a reschedule UID is supplied.
moduleContractTests.then: calls rescheduleSeatedBooking({ ...newSeatedBookingObject, rescheduleUid }, seatedBooking, resultBooking, loggerWithEventDetails)
moduleContractTests.rationale: Reschedule requests must preserve the explicit reschedule path.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Seat creation or rescheduling returns a result booking.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Successful seat operations publish workflow and webhook notifications.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The selected seat operation produces a booking result.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Callers receive the created or rescheduled booking.
